data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Python 3.13 Lambda + Function URL + reserved-concurrency=10 + IAM role (s3:PutObject only on bucket) + CloudWatch log group 7d retention
- dd-2: idempotent rerun
- dd-3: dso-config.conf gets lambda_function_name + iam_role_name + endpoint_url
- dd-4: aws iam simulate-principal-policy on role returns EvalDecision=allowed for s3:PutObject on bucket
- dd-5: missing operator IAM permissions → clear preflight error

Depends on: task e1f7-68d0-8079-4617

## Implementation Notes
Mirror plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-bucket.sh (commit 8c81df65c6) structure. Honor DSO_AWS_CMD + DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD + DSO_CONFIG_FILE env overrides (DSO_CONFIG_FILE is critical for test isolation per bug 3319).

### Execution order (write_config_key positioned EARLY for partial-state recovery)
1. preflight_credentials — sts get-caller-identity; exit 4 on failure
2. preflight_iam — simulate-principal-policy for iam:CreateRole, iam:AttachRolePolicy, iam:PutRolePolicy, iam:PassRole, lambda:CreateFunction, lambda:GetFunction, lambda:CreateFunctionUrlConfig, lambda:PutFunctionConcurrency, logs:CreateLogGroup, logs:PutRetentionPolicy; exit 5 on any Deny + clear stderr naming the action
3. preflight_python_runtime — lambda list-runtimes | grep python3.13; exit non-zero if absent
4. config fail-fast — read review_telemetry.bucket_name; exit 6 if absent
5. ensure_iam_role — get-role → create-role + put-role-policy scoped to s3:PutObject on bucket ARN ONLY (no s3:*, no Resource:"*")
6. write_config_key(iam_role_name) — EARLY
7. ensure_log_group — describe-log-groups → create-log-group + put-retention-policy --retention-in-days 7
8. ensure_lambda_function — get-function → create-function --runtime python3.13; bounded retry-with-backoff (3 attempts, 2/4/8s) for IAM propagation
9. write_config_key(lambda_function_name) — EARLY
10. ensure_function_url — get-function-url-config → create-function-url-config (NO apigateway calls)
11. write_config_key(endpoint_url) — EARLY
12. ensure_reserved_concurrency — put-function-concurrency --reserved-concurrent-executions 10
13. verify_simulate_principal_policy — post-create assertion: simulate-principal-policy on role ARN + s3:PutObject + bucket ARN returns EvalDecision=allowed

Region pinned us-east-1 on every aws call. ShellCheck-clean. set -euo pipefail. chmod +x.

After impl: remove .test-index RED marker for aws-setup-lambda.sh.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Script exists, executable, set -euo pipefail
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-lambda.sh && head -5 plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-lambda.sh | grep -q 'set -euo pipefail'
- [ ] ShellCheck passes
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-lambda.sh
- [ ] All 15 task-1 test cases now pass GREEN
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-lambda.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] DSO_AWS_CMD + DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD + DSO_CONFIG_FILE overrides supported
  Verify: grep -q 'DSO_AWS_CMD' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-lambda.sh && grep -q 'DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-lambda.sh && grep -q 'DSO_CONFIG_FILE' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-lambda.sh
- [ ] IAM policy scoped (no s3:* nor Resource:"*")
  Verify: ! grep -nE '"s3:\\*"|"Resource"\\s*:\\s*"\\*"' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-lambda.sh && grep -q 's3:PutObject' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-lambda.sh
- [ ] Reserved concurrency = 10
  Verify: grep -qE 'reserved-concurrent-executions[[:space:]]+10' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-lambda.sh
- [ ] Log retention = 7 days
  Verify: grep -qE 'retention-in-days[[:space:]]+7' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-lambda.sh
- [ ] Python 3.13 runtime pinned
  Verify: grep -q 'python3\.13' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-lambda.sh
- [ ] Region us-east-1
  Verify: grep -qE 'us-east-1|AWS_DEFAULT_REGION' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-lambda.sh
- [ ] No new external dependencies
  Verify: ! git diff HEAD -- pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^\+' | grep -qE 'boto3|cloudformation'
- [ ] .test-index RED marker removed
  Verify: ! grep -qE 'aws-setup-lambda\.sh.*test-aws-setup-lambda\.sh \[' .test-index
- [ ] No literal plugins/dso/ paths in runtime code (use \${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/ in comments)
  Verify: ! grep -nE '^[^#]*"plugins/dso/' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-lambda.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
